text: English Language and Literature is a discipline that studies English as the object of research, integrating language analysis and literary appreciation. It not only explores the structural rules and evolution history of English, but also deeply interprets literary works expressed in English and the cultural connotations behind them. From Shakespeare's plays to contemporary American novels, from the subtle changes in English pronunciation to cross-cultural communication in a global context, all fall within the scope of this discipline. It is not merely "learning English", but also through this tool of English, understanding the essence of language, the charm of literature, and the diversity of human civilization.
